title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Improve safety and observability of unified rollouts by enhancing canary/A-B/shadow autorollback policies and adding targeted e2e stability tests. This PR implements (1) a metric-quorum based autorollback engine extension to tolerate noisy signals across multi-metric checks, (2) a staged probing window for shadow traffic to detect regressions before weighted traffic shifts, (3) improved telemetry for rollback decisions (trace IDs, contributing metric deltas), and (4) e2e tests and stability guards to prevent flapping on transient anomalies. Checklist: - [x] Extend autorollback engine to support metric quorum and composite thresholds - [x] Add staged shadow probing state and hysteresis for weighted canaries - [x] Emit structured rollback decision events for observability and tracing - [x] Add e2e tests that simulate latency and semantic regression signals - [x] Update rollout docs and release notes - [x] Run full CI and performance bench Summary of changes and rationale: The previous autorollback logic could be triggered by a single noisy metric and produced rapid oscillations during periods of intermittent noise. To address this we implemented a quorum operator that requires K-of-N metrics to breach thresholds before triggering a rollback, with configurable quorum window and decay. Staged shadow probing introduces a short probe-only stage where new model variants receive shadow traffic and are validated on production-like telemetry without impacting live traffic. Once probes pass stability checks, the rollout proceeds to weighted canary. Observability: rollback decisions now emit structured events to redwood.events.rollout_decision including reason, metric contributions, and trace_id to aid post-mortem and automated annotation in Console. Testing: added deterministic unit tests for quorum logic and a new e2e test that runs a simulated rollout with injected latency and semantic drift to validate that the system quarantines and rolls back only when the composite conditions persist. Rollout plan: after merging, enable new defaults on staging for 48h, monitor redwood.rollout.decision and redwood.rollout.stability metrics, then promote to prod with a 1% traffic ramp and 1h staged probe. Related: ENG-4021 (autorollback stability), SUP-1198 (customer incident root cause).

review_thread: Lena Zhang (2025-01-16): Please add an integration test that ensures the quorum logic doesn't block legitimate rollouts under single-metric drift. Aisha: added e2e that simulates single-metric drift and confirms forward progression when quorum not met.

Omar Khan (2025-01-17): Can we expose quorum and window via rollout config with sensible defaults? Aisha: yes, added config fields rollout.policy.quorum.k and rollout.policy.quorum.window_ms with defaults and runtime validation.

Frank Müller (2025-01-18): Observability looks good, but ensure we redact PII from trace annotations. Aisha: confirmed events only include trace_id and metric keys; examples in docs clarified no raw request data is emitted.
Omar Khan (2025-01-19): CI flaky on first run due to test timeout, reran and passed. Approving.
release_notes: Enhanced autorollback: metric-quorum operator to avoid noisy-metric driven rollbacks; staged shadow probing to validate variants before traffic shift; structured rollback decision events for Console and alerting; added e2e tests and docs. Rollout default config updated with quorum and probe windows (backward compatible).
